_purpose: Mature-cohort figures of the primary outcome (the owner's decision, 22 October 2026, option c): the gross prior-year movement over underwriting years u <= t-2 of Equation (1), for every record of the corpus whose stored gross RAG triangle a sign-only precedence rule displaced (the provisions sign-disagreement override, route rag_provisions, or the model-agreement veto, a '[RAG|CODE] PYD NOT APPLIED' note). Built by src/build_mature_cohort_figures.py, which recomputes each figure from the record's stored grid by the extraction's own estimator at the pinned commit and assembles the evidence from results/extraction_error_rate/mature-cohort/ and the error-rate study. figure_m is in millions of the report's own currency (figure_gbp_m at the loader's H.10 rate, for reference). Under ANALYSIS_CONFIG['outcome'] 'mature_cohort' (the primary) run_analysis.py (apply_mature_cohort_figure) adopts figure_m before the basis and cohort decisions and before the FX conversion, writes route 'mature_cohort_triangle' (gross, mature-enforced), and refuses an entry unless every model block of the record shows the displaced gross triangle; under 'precedence_672' the register is not applied. An entry with a figure carries at least two independent agent readings of the filing, each with its reader, pages and cells: the readings of 22 October 2026 and the second readings of the records that round read once (kind 'reading'), and earlier readings of the error-rate study that recomputed the same printed triangle (kind 'error_rate_study'). The extraction's own table read of the printed page (the stored grid the estimator computed from) is kept under table_read as supporting evidence; it is not a reading. notes records a flag a reader raised and the existing rule that decides it. An entry without a figure states its reason (confirmed_figure_register, no_mature_cohort, triangle_figure_stands, outside_working_sample_not_read, aggregated_column_not_like_for_like), and the loader adopts nothing for it. status 'excluded_takeon_not_development' marks a figure whose record data/takeon_not_development.json excludes (an entry there with figure_route 'mature_cohort_triangle'). An entry with an aggregated_column object (the three records of syndicate 1945: 2023 and 2024 on the author's decision of 22 October 2026, 2022 on the decision of the Claude analysis session of 23 October 2026) leaves the stored grid's aggregated development-age column out of the figure (Appendix 2.1): its figure is the estimator's on the grid without the column and its column readers' (F1 and F2 for 2023 and 2024, archived in fx-translation/readings/; X4, Y5, Z1 and Z2 for 2022, archived in round2/readings/), figure_with_column_m is the grid's own, and the earlier readings of that figure are kept under superseded_readings. Its displaced.by is a precedence rule where one displaced the triangle (1945/2024), and 'aggregated_column' where the adopted figure is the triangle's own with the column in it (1945/2022 and 1945/2023). An entry with a correction object (rules 3 and 4 of the round-5 decision rules of 23 October 2026: 318/2024, 1274/2016, 1609/2024 and 2232/2020) replaces the printed table's own figure, the adopted one, with the corrected figure its readings give (archived in round5/readings/); its displaced.by is 'printed_table_error' (a body transposed against its labels, a misprinted cell) or 'previous_report_base' (the year t-1 report's printed cells as the base).
